          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this E.164 value is stored and
            returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is normalized to lower case before being
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            supplied. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed
            table keyed by the city's region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne ->
            VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is rejected with
            400. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. When omitted or false, a create whose
            lastName and address already belong to another owner (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) is rejected with 409;
            when true the create is allowed to proceed. The flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored
                first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the stored
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number
                of owners at the time this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 8
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by the owners of a single household. When an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and their lastName and
                address already belong to an existing owner (compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace), the joiner and the existing household members
                are all assigned this same identifier. It is absent for an owner that does
                not share a household with anyone.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners who already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing this owner's firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). It is zero when no earlier owner shared both names.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits
                of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. It
                starts at 1, gains a level when an email address is present, and gains a
                level when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is zero), capped at 3.
                Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from the stored city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                It is 'UNKNOWN' for any city not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's
                registration date at the time of this response, signalling that the
                daily create volume is approaching the per-day limit; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used to detect duplicate owners: the owner's
                normalized telephone, email (empty when none) and householdId (empty
                when none) joined by '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identity key is identical, so members of one household with different
                telephones have different keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|owner@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

      title: Owner page

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this E.164 value is stored and
            returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is normalized to lower case before being
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            supplied. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed
            table keyed by the city's region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne ->
            VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is rejected with
            400. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. When omitted or false, a create whose
            lastName and address already belong to another owner (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) is rejected with 409;
            when true the create is allowed to proceed. The flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored
                first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the stored
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number
                of owners at the time this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 8
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by the owners of a single household. When an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and their lastName and
                address already belong to an existing owner (compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace), the joiner and the existing household members
                are all assigned this same identifier. It is absent for an owner that does
                not share a household with anyone.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners who already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing this owner's firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). It is zero when no earlier owner shared both names.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits
                of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. It
                starts at 1, gains a level when an email address is present, and gains a
                level when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is zero), capped at 3.
                Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from the stored city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                It is 'UNKNOWN' for any city not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's
                registration date at the time of this response, signalling that the
                daily create volume is approaching the per-day limit; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used to detect duplicate owners: the owner's
                normalized telephone, email (empty when none) and householdId (empty
                when none) joined by '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identity key is identical, so members of one household with different
                telephones have different keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|owner@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this E.164 value is stored and
            returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is normalized to lower case before being
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            supplied. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed
            table keyed by the city's region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne ->
            VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is rejected with
            400. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when supplied it is stored and returned, and drives the
            derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. When omitted or false, a create whose
            lastName and address already belong to another owner (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) is rejected with 409;
            when true the create is allowed to proceed. The flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored
                first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the stored
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number
                of owners at the time this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 8
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by the owners of a single household. When an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and their lastName and
                address already belong to an existing owner (compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace), the joiner and the existing household members
                are all assigned this same identifier. It is absent for an owner that does
                not share a household with anyone.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners who already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing this owner's firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). It is zero when no earlier owner shared both names.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits
                of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. It
                starts at 1, gains a level when an email address is present, and gains a
                level when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is zero), capped at 3.
                Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from the stored city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                It is 'UNKNOWN' for any city not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's
                registration date at the time of this response, signalling that the
                daily create volume is approaching the per-day limit; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used to detect duplicate owners: the owner's
                normalized telephone, email (empty when none) and householdId (empty
                when none) joined by '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identity key is identical, so members of one household with different
                telephones have different keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|owner@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.

        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string

        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80

          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this E.164 value is stored and
            returned.

            syntactically valid address and is normalized to lower case before being
            stored and returned.
          type: string

          maxLength: 255

            supplied. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed
            table keyed by the city's region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne ->
            VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is rejected with
            400. The stored value is returned on read.

            date. The stored value is returned on read.

            Optional; when supplied it is stored and returned, and drives the
            derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

            household with an existing owner. When omitted or false, a create whose
            lastName and address already belong to another owner (compared

            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the stored
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number
                of owners at the time this owner was created.
              type: string

              readOnly: true

              title: Household ID

                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and their lastName and
                address already belong to an existing owner (compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace), the joiner and the existing household members

              type: integer

## Summary

I implemented the `ageBand` derivation for owners. When a request includes `birthDate` (ISO), the owner response now returns `ageBand` computed against `registrationDate`: `MINOR` (under 18), `ADULT` (18–64), or `SENIOR` (65+); it's absent when no `birthDate` is supplied.

Changes, following the codebase's existing conventions:

- **`openapi.yml`** — added `birthDate` (optional, `format: date`) to the editable `OwnerFields` schema, and `ageBand` as a read-only derived string on the `Owner` schema. These regenerate `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` at build time and MapStruct auto-maps them by name (matching how `contactPreference`, `membershipLevel`, etc. already work). I deliberately kept `ageBand` a plain string rather than an OpenAPI `enum` to avoid a generated enum type that would break the MapStruct `String`→enum mapping from the derived getter.
- **`Owner.java`** — added the persistent `birthDate` field (`@Column(name = "birth_date")`) with accessors, plus a derived `getAgeBand()` method that computes the band from `birthDate` against `registrationDate` (falling back to today only if `registrationDate` is somehow unset), mirroring the style of the other derived getters like `getContactPreference()`.
- **`schema.sql`** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `birth_date DATE` column to the `owners` table.
- **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — added the extra `NULL` to each positional owners INSERT so column counts still match (the h2/postgres seed data use explicit column lists and needed no change).

The registration flow required no controller changes: the `birthDate` input flows through the existing `ownerMapper.toOwner(...)` mapping, and `registrationDate` is already resolved before save, so `getAgeBand()` reads a populated reference date on both create and read.
